meta.description: Tells a node about the path it works on: where it is among all paths, how deep it is in the plant, where on its parent it grows and how long it is. A branch or instance reads the path it grows on.

info.description: Position goes from 0 at the first path to 1 at the last, index counts the paths from 0, count is how many there are. Depth is 1 for a stem and one more for every branching. Parent position is where on its parent a path grows, from 0 at the base to 1 at the tip, a stem has 0. Length is how long the path is.
